scientific_quote: Omega-3 content declarations are measured per serving in standardized assays.
Glucosamine quantities are reported per serving for mobility-support formulations.
MSM dosage declarations are represented per discrete serving unit.
Zinc contributions are quantified analytically in dermatology-support blends.
Lutein contributions are measured per serving in antioxidant-support products.
Probiotic viability is measured as live counts per serving.
Daily probiotic dosing ranges are represented by serving-based organism counts.
Taurine concentrations are expressed per serving in cardiometabolic support products.
Omega-3 levels are quantified per serving for metabolic-support products.
Ocular-support carotenoid products report lutein amount per serving unit.
Omega-3 inputs for tear-film stability are listed per serving amount.
